subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should CodexBar support forced browser-cookie refresh as both a CLI command and provider-settings control, and should it promise immediate refresh only for providers with dedicated importers?
rationale: The implementation introduces a new recovery surface that clears persisted authentication cache and has different capabilities across providers; code review cannot safely choose the permanent UX and compatibility contract.

options.title: Support CLI plus settings controls
options.body: Keep both surfaces, but define immediate refresh as OpenCode/OpenCode Go-only for now and make all paths use provider-specific automatic browser order.

options.title: Ship CLI-only recovery
options.body: Retain a documented, scriptable CLI command and defer the settings buttons until the provider-wide UX and failure messaging are agreed.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the change until CodexBar has a consistent provider-wide cookie recovery model and importer coverage.

recommendation.title: Support CLI plus settings controls
recommendation.body: Keep both surfaces, but define immediate refresh as OpenCode/OpenCode Go-only for now and make all paths use provider-specific automatic browser order.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR-head commit metadata ties steipete to the affected cookie-refresh implementation and the product surface being introduced.
